chunks: Their recompense is pardon by their Lord, and gardens with streams of running water where they will abide for ever. How fair is the recompense of those who act!
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for the righteous in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful who maintain steadfastness (istiqamah) amidst trials, highlighting that true reward stems from consistent action rather than mere intention. The phrase 'excellent recompense for the doers' underscores the Shia emphasis on the unity of faith and practice, where good deeds are the tangible manifestation of inner belief. Historically, this verse has been cited to validate the spiritual status of the Imams as the ultimate exemplars of those who 'do good' with sincerity and precision.
